anomalies.observed: All listed VDD and analog supply pins on both MCUs are on explicitly unconnected nets; NAVC1.13 (VDDA) is also not on the 3.3 V rail. NAVC1.1 (VBAT) is connected to +3V3, but that does not supply its VDD pins.
anomalies.expected: The MCU supply pins should be connected to the regulated 3.3 V and ground rails as required. The specification states that 3.3 V feeds both MCUs.
anomalies.impact: With the MCU core supply pins unpowered, the flight-control and navigation processors cannot operate; the board will not perform its intended control or navigation functions.

anomalies.observed: Both FCC1 pins identified as VCAP are connected directly to the UART3 connector pins, and the 2u2 capacitor C13 has an unconnected pad rather than being connected to VCAP.
anomalies.expected: VCAP pins should have their required decoupling capacitors to ground, not be used as UART signals. UART3 signals should connect to appropriate MCU I/O pins.
anomalies.impact: The VCAP supply pins are improperly loaded by connector signals and lack the shown capacitor connection, risking failure of the FCC’s internal regulator. The UART3 connector also cannot function as intended.

anomalies.observed: The FCC crystal is connected to FCC1 PE6/PE7 (pins 5/37), not its PH0/PH1 oscillator pins (pins 12/13). The NAVC crystal nets have no MCU pins connected; NAVC PH0/PH1 instead connect to separate nets with capacitors.
anomalies.expected: As specified, each MCU’s 25 MHz HSE crystal should connect to that MCU’s HSE oscillator input and output pins.
anomalies.impact: Neither MCU has the specified crystal correctly connected to its oscillator pins, so the external high-speed clock will not operate as intended; the processors may fail to start or run with an unintended clock configuration.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows both MCUs’ principal supply pins unconnected, which alone prevents the intended flight-control system from operating. It also shows the FCC VCAP pins repurposed as UART3 lines and both HSE crystal circuits incorrectly connected or left open.
